headline: Peru Regulator Announces Electricity Tariff Reductions for November
summary: Osinergmin reported that electricity tariffs for the National Interconnected System will drop by an average of 2.99%, while commercial and industrial user rates will fall by 4.21% starting November 2026.
why: Lower regulated utility tariffs reduce operating costs for commercial and industrial businesses and provide relief to household consumers.

impacts.name: Industrial and Commercial Sector
impacts.why: Decreased electricity tariffs lower operating overhead for corporate and retail consumers.
